stories.title: NLCS Game 3: Takeaways as Brewers push Dodgers to brink of elimination
stories.summary: Milwaukee kept rolling in Los Angeles, riding five runs over the final three innings to victory.

stories.title: Brewers put Dodgers on brink of sweep, seize 3-0 NLCS lead with Game 3 win
stories.summary: The Brewers got back-to-back home runs to reclaim the lead and went on to a 6-2 win in Game 3 of the NLCS that pushed the Dodgers on the brink of elimination.

stories.title: Rams' Jackson has suspension cut to 1 game following appeal
stories.summary: Alaric Jackson's suspension for punching Bradley Chubb after Monday night's game between the Bills and Rams was reduced from two games to one.

stories.title: Spurs debut three-guard lineup of Fox, Harper, Castle in preseason win
stories.summary: Spurs coach Mitch Johnson finally deployed the three-guard lineup featuring De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper and Stephon Castle in a 123-103 preseason win over the Suns on Wednesday.

stories.title: Sources: FIFA set to change rules that led to Balogun World Cup red card reversal
stories.summary: FIFA is set to amend its rules to prevent a repeat of the controversial reversal of the World Cup suspension issued to Folarin Balogun, sources have told ESPN.
